commands.purpose: scan project facts and create or update the active plan archive
stops_on: an unrelated active plan would be overwritten
the project path cannot be resolved
the preview cannot identify a safe plan destination
never_does: change Git history or publish a release

commands.purpose: inspect and maintain the stable long-term project goal
required_inputs: --set <human project goal> when applying a change
reads: plan.md and docs/VERSIONS.md for conflict detection
stops_on: the proposed goal is a version objective, implementation plan, or technical task
the project path cannot be resolved
an existing human goal would be replaced without an explicit preview
never_does: turn a current version plan into the long-term goal
edit project source code or publish a release

commands.purpose: explain, configure, install, and synchronize the optional Brain memory service
commands.write_flag: configure --apply or an explicit install/sync action
writes: local Brain skeleton only after explicit local or remote setup
approved or project-scoped Brain records during explicit synchronization
stops_on: remote mode has no remote URL
the configured repository identity conflicts with the actual Git remote
synchronization would expose credentials or an unapproved global candidate
never_does: create Brain during ordinary harness init
report local-only mode as a synchronization failure
put prompts, chat transcripts, secrets, or environment variables into Brain events

commands.purpose: inspect and advance one requirement through the controlled delivery gates
reads: the selected requirement and active version
product-review, implementation, QA, and release-readiness evidence
current Git branch and working-tree metadata
writes: requirement-scoped workflow events and artifact references
release-candidate state only when every required gate is satisfied
stops_on: the next gate lacks its required artifact or independent evidence
a destructive, privileged, or externally visible action needs user approval
never_does: merge, push, tag, deploy, or publish automatically
skip product review, implementation, or independent QA gates
combine multiple requirements into one hidden execution
